claim: Config writes take a file lock, build the candidate in memory, validate the whole file, and refuse to write if the file changed on disk while the candidate was prepared; the write goes through a synced temp file persisted over the target.
A share manifest names a snapshot object and a presentation object plus typed resources of kind image, trace or map, and the schema forces a png mime type exactly for images.
Legacy file_lens blocks that fail to parse are dropped silently during lifting rather than failing the read.
Wire columns are UTF-8 byte offsets while the terminal needs cell columns, so the viewer converts through a byteColumn helper that accounts for tab stops and wide characters.
